text.areas-pr-demo.ts: Supplies a map built from the areas payload with a pull request that changes files in three areas, and the readers the harness needs to review it
text.graph-fixtures.ts: Builds deterministic graph maps for navigation, visuals and scale regression
text.macro-sized-demo.ts: Builds a harness map with a pull request and its Macro payload for a chosen number of areas and features, so the areas map can be tried on a small and a large project
text.macro-lab-demo.ts: Turns the generated Orchard Market evaluation project into a harness map with a pull request and its Flow, and its Macro payload with areas
text.macro-sizes-demo.ts: Turns the generated small or large evaluation project into a harness map and its Macro payload with areas, with no pull request
text.pr-review-demo.ts: Supplies synthetic pull request maps with their demo flow, a richer one with long texts and five-step rows, and the demo files its steps point at, branch overlays, source files and diffs
text.scenarios.json: Declares deterministic graph visual and performance scenarios
